make_buy_boundaries.material_route: Raw material plus yield/waste, process labour, equipment, tooling amortisation, consumables, QA, handling, freight and installation; no all-finished-equipment price per unresolved structural kilogram.
make_buy_boundaries.buy_route: Use matched assembly scope, rating, quantity tier, transport, commissioning and inspection; add missing parts explicitly.
make_buy_boundaries.unknown_items: Remain explicit bounded process/equipment estimates rather than zero.
make_buy_boundaries.current_material_floor: For stale aluminium offers below current A00 benchmark, keep observation but calculate current metal plus declared conversion instead of applying an extra discount.
make_buy_boundaries.service_battery: No generic EV cell$/kWh substituted for the selected service-battery module assembly.
make_buy_boundaries.propulsion: Motor/VFD price observations provide no moving force/current/thermal/receiving-brake validation.

limitations: Supplier listings have no firm validity or received quote. Published observation date is not a claimed offer revision date.
No supplier was contacted; no order or procurement approval was issued.
No claim of grade compliance, installed mass, available thrust or physical acceptance.
No freight, duty or Iraqi landed-cost assumption is embedded; coordinator must price those once at correct commercial scope.
Official China domestic-circulation prices include circulation margins/taxes per NBS methodology and are not directlyFOB export offers.
Dataset includes two explicitly scoped comparison observations for seats/HVAC beyond the core material/motor/VFD observations.
